answers.goal: To be a part of a project that I love, whether I’m an actor, director, writer, etc. I want to work on something that inspires others and makes them feel moved or understood.
answers.drew: Movies and TV drew me into the entertainment industry.
answers.seeking: Other creatives who are passionate about projects and genres that I’m interested in. Am open to networking with everyone in the industry and learning more.
answers.inspiration: My biggest inspiration would have to be Jake Gyllenhaal. As an actor he has so much range and an incredible filmography of films that I would only dream I could be a part of.
